item.title: Toshaos, councillors and hinterland leaders to get stipend boost
item.description: The government has approved increased stipends for toshaos, deputy toshaos, senior councillors and Regional Democratic Council (RDC) councillors. Under the new arrangements, stipends for regional councillors on RDCs will go from $30,000 to $50,000.
